items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well, uh, Sinted Esbien was top.

ctx.x: I wouldn't have that kind of a piece of it. Let me turn it off for a second so I can look up some more questions here. Okay. What would you say the top band during the 1930s was around town? Which one got the most work? Depression kids.
Well, uh, Sinted Esbien was top.
He got a lot of work and everything?
